title: Billing and Coding: Ambulatory Electrocardiograph (AECG) Monitoring

codes.1: Note: Providers are reminded to refer to the long descriptors of the CPT codes in their CPT book.

covered.1: It is the provider’s responsibility to select codes carried out to the highest level of specificity and selected from the ICD-10-CM code book appropriate to the year in which the service is rendered for the claim(s) submitted. The following ICD-10-CM codes support medical necessity and provide coverage for CPT/HCPCS codes: 93224, 93225, 93226, 93227, 93228, 93229, 93241, 93242, 93243, 93244, 93245, 93246, 93247, 93248, 93268, 93270, 93271, 93272, 93298, 0937T, 0938T, 0939T, and 0940T.

noncovered.1: All those not listed under the “ICD-10-CM Codes that Support Medical Necessity” section of this article.
